name: redoc
readme_excerpt: Learn what's coming in Redoc 3.x → Generate beautiful API documentation from OpenAPI About Redoc Redoc is an open source tool for generating documentation from OpenAPI (formerly Swagger) definitions. By default Redoc offers a three-panel, responsive layout: - The left panel contains a search bar and navigation menu. - The central panel contains the documentation. - The right panel contains request and response examples.
